props.gloss_en: R' Yehoshua ben Levi: at every utterance that went forth from the mouth of the Holy One, the souls of Israel departed
as it is said: 'my soul departed when he spoke' (Song 5:6)
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: and since their souls departed at the first utterance, how did they receive the second? He brought down the dew with which He will in future revive the dead, and revived them
as it is said: 'a bounteous rain You poured down, O God; Your inheritance, when it was weary, You established it' (Ps 68:10)
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: at every utterance that went forth from the mouth of the Holy One, Israel drew back twelve mil, and the ministering angels led them
as it is said: 'the angels of hosts yidodun yidodun' (Ps 68:13)
do not read yidodun ('they flee') but yedadun ('they lead')
